study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Wolfers et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2021
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Replicating extensive brain structural heterogeneity in individuals with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study and selected from the NoDa database. The study uses three non-overlapping samples (Discovery, Replication 1, Replication 2) from this cohort.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: All participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study... The two replication samples were selected from the TOP-database... As the discovery sample, we selected 256 healthy individuals...
